items.html: Know that the eight ways drawn in the skull opposite the face — four opposite the right cheek and four opposite the left cheek — are such that the place of the skull opposite the nose intervenes between them. Thus there are four ways on the right side, opposite the nose, and four ways opposite the left of the nose; hence there are eight ways opposite the face, and only four ways opposite the back. Now through these thirteen white ways the light of the skull, the first head of Arich Anpin, issues forth and shines through those ways in the secret of diminishing the light, so that it can be received.
